dormitory.note: Gwanak Residence Halls undergraduate monthly fee KRW 139,800–278,100 depending on building (Global Bldg double room 278,100); deposit equal to one month; only monthly fees published, no per-semester figure
dormitory.evidence: The Gwanak Residence Halls consist of 27 buildings in total, accommodating approximately 6,200 students. ... Both undergraduate and graduate students are eligible to apply

gks_participating.evidence: The Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) Degree Program is a Korean government scholarship program designed to foster global talent

language_rules.note: TOPIK or TOPIK IBT; scores obtained on or after 2024-07-09. Alternatives: other standardized results or proof all high-school courses were in Korean/English

Completion of Level 4 at language centers in Korean universities

scholarships.name: SNU Global Talent Scholarship I
scholarships.renewal: must satisfy the minimum academic performance requirement
scholarships.evidence: Global Talent Scholarship I | Full tuition waiver for 8 semesters (4 years) and a monthly living allowance of KRW 1,000,000 | 1
scholarships.name_display_ko: 학부 신입생 장학 (등록금 전액 8학기, 월 생활비 100만 원)

scholarships.name: SNU Global Talent Scholarship II
scholarships.evidence: Global Talent Scholarship II | Full tuition waiver for 2 semesters (1 year) and a monthly living allowance of KRW 1,000,000 | 3
scholarships.name_display_ko: 학부 신입생 장학 (등록금 전액 2학기, 월 생활비 100만 원)

scholarships.name: SNU Global Talent Scholarship III
scholarships.evidence: Global Talent Scholarship III | Full tuition waiver for 1 semester | 20 ... No separate application is required. Scholarship recipients are selected during the admission process

scholarships.name: SNU Global Scholarships I, II
scholarships.gpa_requirement: minimum term GPA 3.0 and cumulative 3.0 to continue
scholarships.living_allowance: monthly 1,200,000 KRW (in one award table; a second table lists tuition 1 semester and optional 10-week Korean language training)
scholarships.renewal: renewable up to a maximum four(4) semesters, contingent upon minimum term GPA of 3.0
scholarships.application_period: June and December (upon admission to SNU)
scholarships.evidence: Tuition | 1 semester | Living Allowances | monthly 1,200,000 KRW | Airfare | Economy seat(Only for freshmen) ... The GS scholarship is renewable up to a maximum four(4) semesters

scholarships.name: Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS)
scholarships.name_en: Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS)
scholarships.renewal: renewable up to a maximum four(4) semesters, contingent upon the recipient maintaining a minimum term GPA of 3.0
scholarships.application_period: During the admission application period for international students every semester
scholarships.nationality_restriction: graduates from universities in East, Southeast, and Central Asia (students in China and Japan not eligible)
scholarships.evidence: Newly-admitted graduates from universities in East, Southeast, and Central Asia(i.e., students in China and Japan are not eligible) ... Tuition | 4 semesters maximum | Full Tuition Fee | Living Expenses | 500,000 KRW monthly
scholarships.name_official_en: Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS)

scholarships.name: SNU President Fellowship (SPF)
scholarships.living_allowance: KRW 1,500,000 monthly stipend for 4 years (OGA page); guide says KRW 1,500,000–2,000,000 for 3 to 4 years
scholarships.duration: Full tuition fee for six semesters
scholarships.renewal: renewable up to a maximum six(6) semesters, contingent upon minimum term GPA of 3.0
scholarships.nationality_restriction: faculty of universities without Ph.D. from developing countries
scholarships.evidence: a faculty of major universities WITHOUT Ph.D. degree from developing countries in Asia, Africa, South America etc. ... Full tuition fee for six semesters | Living Expenses | KRW 1,500,000 monthly stipend for 4 years*

scholarships.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) Degree Program
scholarships.evidence: The Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) Degree Program is a Korean government scholarship program ... (listed under both Scholarships for Graduate Students and Scholarships for Undergraduate Students)

scholarships.name: Overseas Koreans Scholarship
scholarships.evidence: Overseas Korean students who wish to take graduate degrees at SNU ... Full tuition exemption for a maximum of 4 semesters (Only when conditions are met)

scholarships.name: Global Hope Scholarship
scholarships.name_en: Global Hope Scholarship (Samsung Dream Scholarship Foundation)
scholarships.application_period: July for fall semester, January for spring semester
scholarships.nationality_restriction: developing countries in the DAC list of ODA Recipients
scholarships.evidence: International students from the developing countries in the DAC list of ODA Recipients. ... Tuition | 8 semesters maximum | Full/Partial Tuition Fee | Living Expenses | 600,000 KRW monthly
scholarships.name_display_ko: 개발도상국 출신 학생 장학 (등록금 전액·일부, 월 생활비 60만 원)

scholarships.name: Korean War Memorial Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.application_period: Any time during the academic year
scholarships.nationality_restriction: direct descendants of international Korean War veterans
scholarships.evidence: awarded to the direct descendent of international Korean War veterans who applied to study undergraduate or graduate programs in Korea and recommended by the Korean War Memorial Foundation
